measurement_scope.elapsed_seconds: Starts after WordPress/test setup; includes synthetic fixture generation, prepare/review/render/preview, exact original-source and retained-preview verification and immutable API replays. Excludes process/bootstrap startup.
measurement_scope.stage_seconds: Wall time for each complete public workflow API, including journal/context/artifact validation.
measurement_scope.allocator_peak: Whole PHP worker allocated memory after peak reset before fixture construction; baseline includes loaded WordPress/plugin/test runner.
measurement_scope.process_rss_peak: Linux /proc/self/status VmHWM, cumulative process maximum including bootstrap. This recorded run selected only this four-test class. Earlier allocations when the test runs inside a full suite can raise VmHWM; this is not a per-stage delta or a host-capacity certificate.
measurement_scope.fixture: 1024x1024 low-entropy synthetic white square with supplied eight-bit grayscale constant-128 matte; exact expected RGBA encoded through existing codec. No animal, segmentation, artist or supplier data.

coverage: full hard pixel boundary 1048576 and existing byte ceiling16777216
review->render->exact retained preview, unchanged original source PNG bytes/hash, and unchanged canonical journal replay
one-byte output bound fails preparation without result or GENERATED
explicit one-second review and render deadlines: one scoped journal SELECT delayed1.1seconds; attempt leaves immutable prior journal unchanged, no result, retry succeeds
cancellation denies render/preview with no result
revoked shop denies render/preview/source and leaves journal unchanged
limitations: Single local PHP8.4.26 worker and low-entropy square only; no concurrency or representative animal workload performance certification.

Measured full-worker memory exceeds64MiB before the raster work and at peak; scenario and sum of workflow stages exceed10seconds. Per-operation bounded results do not certify an end-to-end10second budget.
Injected deadlines exercise workflow rollback/gating, not OS CPU preemption or memory-limit enforcement.
No automatic retries, external calls, authentic v0.5 document, licensing, commercial/artistic acceptance, segmentation or supplier geometry inferred.
Existing hard caps, runtime code, historical compositor receipts and catalog acceptance states are unchanged.
